units.reason: Adds a new persisted compaction hint to block meta.json that drives planner segregation and inOrderBlocksMaxTime.
units.headline: New setter adds from-selected-series hint to block compaction meta
units.summary: Idempotently appends the from-selected-series hint to BlockMetaCompaction.Hints and keeps them sorted. The hint is written to meta.json and excludes the block from inOrderBlocksMaxTime, so older readers that do not know the hint would treat such blocks as regular in-order blocks.
focus: Older Prometheus/Mimir versions reading a block with the unknown from-selected-series hint will count it toward inOrderBlocksMaxTime after a downgrade
Sorting Hints in place is consistent with SetStaleSeries/SetOutOfOrder ordering expectations

risk_signals: drives compaction planning and WAL-replay cutoff
units.reason: Predicate used by planner, CompactBlockMetas, Write and inOrderBlocksMaxTime to decide segregation and head truncation.
units.headline: New predicate reports whether block carries from-selected-series hint
units.summary: Returns whether the from-selected-series hint is present in Hints. Its result decides block-class segregation in the planner and exclusion from inOrderBlocksMaxTime, which governs head truncation.
focus: All callers that previously checked only FromStaleSeries (e.g. inOrderBlocksMaxTime) now also check this predicate

units.reason: New unit test only; cannot affect production behavior.
units.headline: Test covers selected-series hint set, idempotency, coexistence with stale hint
units.summary: Adds a test checking that the hint is absent initially, set once, idempotent, and coexists with the stale-series hint. Test-only, no production impact.

units.reason: Changes how blocks are grouped for compaction; mistakes can merge partial-view blocks and drop WAL-only data.
units.headline: Planner segregates selected-series blocks as a third compaction class
units.summary: Blocks are now split into stale, selected and no-hint classes; when more than one class is present, the planner tries no-hint first, then stale, then selected. This prevents selected-series blocks from being merged with regular blocks and losing their hint, which would advance the WAL-replay cutoff.
focus: Blocks carrying both stale and selected hints fall into the stale class via switch ordering
Selected-series blocks are planned only when neither no-hint nor stale classes have work, so they wait behind both
Overlapping selected and regular blocks are never merged and stay separate on disk until retention

units.reason: Only the doc comment changed; the function body is untouched, so behavior cannot change.
units.headline: planClass doc comment mentions selected-series hint class
units.summary: Updates the doc comment to say a class may be the selected-series hint as well as the stale-series hint. No code changed, so a line-by-line review can be skipped.

units.reason: Merged block meta now carries the selected-series hint, changing inOrderBlocksMaxTime and future planning for that block.
units.headline: Merged block keeps from-selected-series hint when any source has it
units.summary: When compacting blocks, the result gets the from-selected-series hint if any source carries it, just as it does for the stale hint. Thanks to planner segregation this is equivalent to requiring all sources, and it fails safe by excluding the block from the cutoff if segregation is bypassed.
focus: Any-source semantics: if a mixed merge ever happens, the merged block (which includes regular data) is excluded from inOrderBlocksMaxTime, so the head keeps more WAL data rather than less

units.reason: Head-view block writes now persist the selected-series hint from the base meta, which affects truncation and planning.
units.headline: Write propagates selected-series hint from base meta to new block
units.summary: When a base meta has the from-selected-series hint, the written block's meta gets it too, mirroring the stale-series handling. CompactSelectedSeries depends on this to tag its blocks.
focus: Base meta passed by compactHeadViewLocked's configure callback is the only source of the hint for head-view blocks

units.reason: New test only; partly moved setup code, no production impact.
units.headline: Test CompactSelectedSeries evicts chosen series and tags the block
units.summary: Checks that selected non-stale series are evicted, the remaining series stays, HeadMinTime does not move, one block with the selected-series hint is written, and the metrics update. Test-only.
